notablePrerequisites:
Trespasser's Curse attached to you.
You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Draw a card.
Nadir Kraken triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Tentacle creature token and put a +1/+1 counter on Nadir Kraken.
The Tentacle enters the battlefield, triggering Trespasser's Curse.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Tentacle, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Trespasser's Curse trigger, causing you to lose 1 life and gain 1 life.
Vilis triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.
